meta.home_title: Dual Messenger+ – Two WhatsApp accounts on one iPhone
meta.home_description: Use your second WhatsApp account on the iPhone or iPad you already carry. App lock with Face ID, voice messages to text, an on-device AI bot, notes and reminders.
meta.privacy_description: How Dual Messenger+ handles your data: no account, no ads, no trackers, and what you create stays on your device.
meta.terms_description: The terms for using the Dual Messenger+ app and website, including subscriptions.

hero.lede: Add your second account in seconds and keep work and personal chats separate.
hero.fine: Free to download. For iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo.
hero.alt: Dual Messenger+ start screen with the Log In button

features.title: More than a second account
features.lede: A lock for your chats and a few everyday tools, built into the same app.

items.title: Lock it with Face ID or your passcode
items.text: Only you can open the app and your chats. Choose whether it locks right away or after a few minutes.
items.alt: Lock screen that says DualMessenger+ Locked, with a Use Face ID button

items.title: Voice messages, turned into text
items.text: Transcribe voice messages and audio files in your language, then copy the text anywhere.
items.alt: Voice To Text screen with three voice notes and their transcriptions

items.title: An AI bot that runs on your device
items.text: Ask quick questions, even offline. Your conversations with the bot never leave your phone.
items.alt: Chat Bot screen with a conversation about planning the day

items.title: Notes and reminders next to your chats
items.text: Write things down, find them with search, and get a notification when a reminder is due.
items.alt: Notes screen with a search field and four notes

also.title: Sticker packs
also.text: Add ready-made sticker packs to WhatsApp and use them in any chat.

also.title: Fancy fonts
also.text: Type your text, pick one of 8 styles and copy it into a message.

also.title: Location sharing
also.text: See where you are on the map and send it as a link.

also.title: iPad multitasking
also.text: Keep Dual Messenger+ open side by side with your calendar, browser or any other app.

how.title: Set up in three steps
how.lede: You need the phone that has your second WhatsApp account, just for a moment.

steps.title: Open Dual Messenger+
steps.text: Tap Log In. A QR code appears on the screen.

steps.title: Open WhatsApp on your other phone
steps.text: Go to Settings, then Linked Devices, and tap Link a Device.

steps.title: Scan the code
steps.text: Point that phone at the QR code. Your chats open in Dual Messenger+.

how.note: WhatsApp keeps a linked device signed in as long as you use WhatsApp on your phone at least once every 14 days.

privacy.title: Your chats stay between you and WhatsApp
privacy.lede: Dual Messenger+ has no servers that see your messages. There is no account to create, and the app has no ads or trackers.

facts.title: Stored on your device
facts.text: Notes, reminders, recordings and bot conversations are saved on your iPhone or iPad.

facts.title: Nothing to sign up for
facts.text: You don’t give us a name, an email address or a phone number.

facts.title: Face ID stays on your device
facts.text: Face ID and Touch ID are handled by your device. The app never receives biometric data.

items.q: Do I still need my second phone?
items.a: Yes, but you don’t have to carry it. Your second account stays on that phone. You use it once to scan the QR code, then open WhatsApp on it at least once every 14 days to stay signed in.

items.q: Is Dual Messenger+ made by WhatsApp?
items.a: No. Dual Messenger+ is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by WhatsApp or Meta.

The app is free to download. Premium features need a subscription, which you can buy weekly, monthly or yearly. Prices are shown in the app before you buy, and you can cancel at any time in your App Store account settings.

items.q: Which devices does it work on?
items.a: iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo with iOS 16 or later. Using two accounts inside the app needs iOS 17 or later.
In WhatsApp on your phone, go to Settings, then Linked Devices, tap the device and choose Log Out. You can also remove an account inside Dual Messenger+.

items.q: Which languages does the app speak?
items.a: 15 languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), Dutch, French, German, Hebrew, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish and Turkish.

closing.title: Your second account, one tap away
closing.text: Download Dual Messenger+ for iPhone and iPad.
